description: A nine-panel composite figure that mixes TEM bright-field imaging, EDS elemental mapping and electron diffraction, all of the same submicron-sized particle in the HR68 sample. (a) is a TEM-BF image of a single oval submicron particle; a red circle marks the region analysed, with a 100 nm scale bar and the instrument label "Ch 1". (b)-(h) are the corresponding EDS maps, each with a 100 nm scale bar: (b) Fe (red), (c) Mn (green), (d) Al (blue), (e) C (cyan), (f) Nb (magenta), (g) Mo (orange) and (h) W (yellow). In (b)-(d) the particle appears dark against a bright matrix, i.e. Fe, Mn and Al are depleted inside the particle; (f) shows strong Nb enrichment confined to the particle; (e) is uniform with no particle outline; (g) and (h) show only sparse scattered counts with no particle contrast. (i) is the SAED pattern of the particle, labelled "Zone = [1 1 0]", with circled reflections indexed (0 0 2̄), (1̄ 1 1) and (1 1̄ 1). Together the panels show the submicron particle is a Nb-rich, Fe/Mn/Al-depleted phase with a face-centred cubic structure.
measured_quantities: elemental distribution maps (Fe, Mn, Al, C, Nb, Mo, W)

observations.observation: Panel (a) is a TEM bright-field image of a single oval submicron-sized particle with a 100 nm scale bar and the label 'Ch 1'.
In the EDS maps (b) Fe, (c) Mn and (d) Al the particle appears dark against a bright matrix, showing depletion of Fe, Mn and Al inside the particle.
Panel (f) shows the Nb map with the particle as a bright oval against a dark background, indicating strong Nb enrichment in the submicron particle.
The C map (e) is uniformly speckled with no particle outline, while the Mo (g) and W (h) maps contain only sparse scattered counts with no particle contrast.
Panel (i) is a selected-area electron diffraction pattern labelled 'Zone = [1 1 0]' with circled reflections indexed (0 0 2̄), (1̄ 1 1) and (1 1̄ 1).
Every panel carries a 100 nm scale bar, so all EDS maps and the TEM image cover the same submicron field of view.

The caption states that (a) is a TEM-BF image and (b)-(h) are corresponding EDS maps of Fe, Mn, Al, C, Nb, Mo and W of the submicron-sized particle in the HR68 sample, with (i) the corresponding SAED pattern.
The citing text states the submicron-sized spherical particles were distributed homogeneously in the austenite matrix in the hot-rolled samples.
The citing text gives mean particle sizes of 261 ± 36 nm, 256 ± 42 nm and 259 ± 23 nm and volume fractions of ~0.193%, ~0.201% and ~0.198% for the HR45, HR68 and HR82 samples respectively.
The citing text states the crystal structure of the precipitates was identified as face-centred cubic (FCC) with a calculated lattice parameter of 4.36 Å, as shown in Fig. 3.

The citing text reports micron-sized polygonal precipitates along the rolling direction at grain boundaries and grain interiors with sizes from 1 to 25 μm, distinct from the submicron particles mapped here.

subfigures.description: TEM bright-field micrograph of one oval/elliptical submicron-sized particle sitting in the matrix; a red circle is drawn over its centre (region used for SAED); 100 nm scale bar at bottom right and the label 'Ch 1' at bottom left.
EDS map of Fe (red) over the same field; the particle region is dark against a bright Fe-rich matrix, indicating Fe depletion inside the particle. 100 nm scale bar.
EDS map of Mn (green); the particle is dark against a bright matrix, indicating Mn depletion in the particle. 100 nm scale bar.
EDS map of Al (blue); the particle outline appears darker than the surrounding matrix, indicating Al depletion. 100 nm scale bar.
EDS map of C (cyan); the signal is uniformly speckled across the whole field with no visible particle outline, i.e. no local C enrichment. 100 nm scale bar.
EDS map of Nb (magenta); the particle is a bright, sharply outlined oval against a dark background, showing strong Nb enrichment confined to the submicron particle. 100 nm scale bar.
EDS map of Mo (orange); only sparse isolated bright dots on a dark background, with no particle-shaped feature, i.e. very weak/low Mo signal. 100 nm scale bar.
EDS map of W (yellow); sparse scattered bright dots on a dark background with no particle outline, i.e. very weak W signal. 100 nm scale bar.

SAED pattern of the particle with the text label 'Zone = [1 1 0]'; discrete spot reflections are indexed (0 0 2̄), (1̄ 1 1) and (1 1̄ 1), each marked by a white circle, and the bright central transmitted beam is visible.

unreadable_items: The bright spots in the Mo (g) and W (h) maps are very sparse and low in intensity; it cannot be judged from the image whether the weak signal is intrinsic or an acquisition-count limitation.
No numeric values (composition in at.%/wt.%, d-spacings) are printed on any panel; only the [110] zone-axis label and reflection indices are legible.
